drafts.subject: Adverse news — Apex Harbour Trading Limited
drafts.body:
To: yiyangyao2@gmail.com
Subject: [Demonstration] Adverse news — Apex Harbour Trading Limited

SYNTHETIC HACKATHON DATA - NOT FOR CUSTOMER, CREDIT, COMPLIANCE, RISK, REGULATORY OR BUSINESS DECISION-MAKING

Dear colleague,

This is a demonstration alert generated from the synthetic book as at 30 Sep 2026. It is addressed to yiyangyao2@gmail.com so it can be sent on manually. It is not a credit decision.

News
18 Sep 2026. Mainland distributor receipts reported about six weeks slower.
Source: Credit Risk Alert Portal (demonstration feed).
A trade note says a named distributor is paying Apex Harbour Trading about six weeks late. The note does not state a loss amount.

Materiality
The item is treated as material because the score is 90.
Exposure: HKD 84,800,000.
Security coverage: 0.42.
Guarantor: none on file.
Financial strength: rating 6.
Open warning signals: 2.

Credit implication
The onshore borrower remains the named customer in Wholesale trade. Slower receipts tighten cash available for the revolving facility. Drawn exposure is HKD 84,800,000. Collateral of type Receivables is HKD 36,000,000. Coverage does not eliminate the exposure.

Follow-up for the relationship manager (Casey Chan)
Ask for a monthly receivable ageing and identify whether the named distributor is the same debtor supporting the receivable charge. Bring the result to the next review. Do not treat this note as an instruction to downgrade, to call default, or to exit the relationship.

Dear colleague,

This is a demonstration industry alert for the synthetic portfolio as at 30 Sep 2026.

What is rising
Wholesale trade has 7 customers and drawn exposure of HKD 168,400,000.
Stage 2 names: 4.
Rating migrations this period: 1.
Open warning signals: 2.
Accounts with days past due: 1.
A sector note on 2 Oct 2026 describes slower orders. Apex Harbour Trading also has a named-distributor receipt delay dated 18 Sep 2026.

Effect on the book
The industry is large enough, and two names are already rating 6, that the signals are material to the portfolio rather than a single keyword hit. Collateral recorded against the industry is HKD 85,488,000.

Recommended review
Open a wholesale-trade portfolio review. Start with Apex Harbour Trading and Repulse Bay Furnishings. Confirm receivable performance, interest-coverage headroom, and any repayment above HKD 5,000,000 inside the next quarter.

drafts.subject: Covenant headroom — Apex Harbour Trading Limited
drafts.body:
To: yiyangyao2@gmail.com
Subject: [Demonstration] Covenant headroom — Apex Harbour Trading Limited

SYNTHETIC HACKATHON DATA - NOT FOR CUSTOMER, CREDIT, COMPLIANCE, RISK, REGULATORY OR BUSINESS DECISION-MAKING

Dear colleague,

This is a demonstration covenant alert as at 30 Sep 2026. The scenario is stated. It is not a forecast promise.

Current test
Interest coverage covenant: at least 2.0 times.
Credit assumption at approval: 2.5 times.
Latest extracted coverage: 2.2 times.
Status today: inside the covenant.

Scenario
Revenue decline of 15 percent, using the trade-friction news as the reason to run the case, with margin and funding cost held at the latest extract.
Projected interest coverage: 1.6 times.
Headroom against the 2.0 times threshold: -0.4 times.
Principal driver: lower revenue through the coverage ratio. Collateral and the guarantee, if any, are not restated by this scenario.

Follow-up
Ask Casey Chan to review management accounts and the receivable ageing before the next test date. The monitoring plan is a recommendation. It is not a credit approval.
